description: Get the AI-scored insights for a company's recent earnings calls — the management-tone read (a net tone score and a hedging score) and the call's key themes with their computed mention counts and per-theme tone. Newest call first. Verifier-approved — only scored and approved calls appear, so quarters can be missing from the sequence (a gap note flags non-consecutive quarters). Use it to gauge how confident or guarded management sounded and what they talked about most.

fiscalQuarter.description: Company fiscal quarter, 1-4. Quarter alone filters that quarter across fiscal years; both fields select an exact period.

fiscalYear.description: Company fiscal year. Omit both period fields for newest results; year alone filters that fiscal year.

limit.description: Maximum number of scored calls to return, newest first (default 2, max 8; values outside 1-8 are clamped)

name: GetEarningsCallToneAndThemes
title: Earnings Call Tone and Themes
